description: Schema for collecting human hantavirus case, outbreak, and surveillance records from public health sources.

core_fields.name: disease
core_fields.description: Standard disease name. Use Hantavirus disease.

core_fields.name: virus_or_syndrome
core_fields.description: Specific virus or syndrome if stated, such as HPS, HFRS, Andes virus, Seoul virus, Sin Nombre virus, Hantaan virus, Puumala virus, or Dobrava-Belgrade virus.

core_fields.name: country
core_fields.description: Country where the human cases or outbreak occurred. Prefer WHO-standard country names when possible.

core_fields.name: subnational_location
core_fields.description: State, province, city, county, district, hospital, or other subnational location as stated in the source.

core_fields.name: date_reported
core_fields.description: Date when the data were reported or published. Keep partial dates if only month/year are available.

core_fields.name: event_start_date
core_fields.description: Start date of the outbreak or case event if explicitly stated.

core_fields.name: event_end_date
core_fields.description: End date of the outbreak or case event if explicitly stated. Do not calculate if not stated.

core_fields.name: cases_probable
core_fields.description: Probable human cases, according to the source definition.

core_fields.name: cases_suspected
core_fields.description: Suspected human cases, according to the source definition.

core_fields.name: cases_unspecified
core_fields.description: Human cases where confirmation status is not clearly stated.

core_fields.name: deaths
core_fields.description: Deaths attributed to the hantavirus case event or outbreak.

core_fields.name: case_definition
core_fields.description: How cases are defined in the source, such as confirmed, suspected, probable, clinical, laboratory-confirmed, HPS, or HFRS.

core_fields.name: source_url
core_fields.description: URL of the source from which the record was extracted.

core_fields.name: source_type
core_fields.description: Source type, such as official_public_health_agency, international_organization_report, peer_reviewed_literature, news_and_situation_report, or structured_database.

core_fields.name: evidence_quote
core_fields.description: Verbatim source text supporting the extracted record.

extraction_rules: Extract only human case, outbreak, or surveillance records.
Do not extract rodent-only surveillance unless human cases are also reported.
Do not calculate duration, CFR, or other derived quantities unless explicitly stated in the source.
Keep confirmed, probable, suspected, and unspecified cases separate.
Use null when a field is not explicitly stated.
Every extracted record must include source_url and evidence_quote.
Preserve the source's wording for case_definition when possible.
